name: tinker-node-manager
description: Manage local Node.js versions with fnm

zh-CN.name: Node 管理
zh-CN.description: 使用 fnm 管理本机 Node.js 版本

list_versions.description: List locally installed Node.js versions managed by fnm, including aliases and default status.

list_remote_versions.description: List remote Node.js versions from the Node.js distribution mirror (fnm list-remote). Optionally filter by text or LTS-only.

lts_only.description: If true, only return LTS releases

filter.description: Optional filter matched against version or LTS codename (e.g. 22, Jod)

install_version.description: Install a Node.js version via fnm. Accepts a version string (e.g. 22, 22.11.0, lts/jod), or lts / latest.

version.description: Version to install (e.g. 22, v22.11.0, lts, latest)

uninstall_version.description: Uninstall a locally installed Node.js version by version id (e.g. v22.11.0).

version.description: Installed version id or number (e.g. v22.11.0)

set_default.description: Set the default Node.js version used by fnm.

version.description: Installed version id or number (e.g. v22.11.0)
